page.overview:
Who is Stretcher?

{| class="wikitable" style="border-collapse:collapse;"

!style="border:1px solid black" colspan=2|Generation 1

Stretcher was available carded in the 1990 series of A Real American Hero toys. ---- Appearance: dark grey cap with black chinstrap; black hair; light gray shirt with rolled up sleeves and blue collar; green backpack straps and gray holster and gloves; grey pants with green belt and yellow panel on left leg; grey boots with green pads

Accessories: large, dark green rectangular tech backpack with detachable antenna; dark grey, top-loading flare pistol; small, round, black flashlight; dark grey hoversled with detachable control stick and clear triangular forward shield with red (sticker) circles. ---- [http://www.yojoe.com/action/90/stretcher.shtml YoJoe.com page]/[http://www.yojoe.com/filecard/90/stretcher.shtml Filecard]
